title: Review of c31's crawlers from noise on fresh seeds 4 and 5: S, I and B replicate (layer rim/core 3.5-3.8); crawling is visible, but no labkit track reaches 3 body lengths (1.5-1.6) because the crawlers grow by absorbing cells and their tracks restart
summary: labkit re-runs of the claimed world (unchanged, t=16, 80 frames) on seeds 4 and 5. From the random two-phase field (first frame of each sheet), curvature flow leaves round cells by t~0.6-1.4, each with its own s ring (aggregate s rim/core 3.49 and 3.82, rim/out 11.5 and 7.13; 9/14 and 19/22 individuals membrane-like). On seed 4 one large cell polarises by t~4 and crawls as a half-moon, trailing cargo and absorbing the static cells it meets, to t=16; on seed 5 several cells polarise and crawl. labkit counts 1 and 3 long-lived moving tracks with a best displacement of 1.5 and 1.6 body lengths: each absorption ends the track (6 and 5 merges, longest track 46 and 81 frames), and the cell's body length grows as it absorbs, so the 3 body-length gate is not met on these seeds by labkit's measure (the claim reports 1.4-3.6, with 3.6 on seed 1).

observations.B: rerun_s4/FACTS.md and rerun_s5/FACTS.md: s rim/core 3.49 and 3.82, rim/out 11.5 and 7.13
observations.M: against: best labkit displacement 1.5 (seed 4) and 1.6 (seed 5) body lengths; rerun_s4/sheet.png t=4-16 shows a half-moon crawler moving with a cargo trail, but its track ends at each absorption

seeds_run.result: partial: S, I, B pass; M 1.5 BL by labkit
partial: S, I, B pass; M 1.6 BL by labkit

not_checked: displacement of a crawler followed through its absorptions (a merge-aware tracker might pass 3 BL)
verdicts.limitation: M may be under-measured: the crawlers grow by absorbing static cells, which ends labkit tracks and enlarges the body length; a merge-aware track of the large crawler could pass 3 body lengths, but I did not measure it. The cells come from a thresholded noise field, so their initial size distribution is set by the threshold and smoothing.
